scope: Primary literature and author/official code survey for long-sequence state and memory, hybrid recurrence, structured self-supervision, distillation context, optimization horizons, distribution robustness, and sequence-local adaptation. No local training, fitting, inference, or benchmark execution.

sources.title: Mamba-3: Improved Sequence Modeling using State Space Principles
sources.verified_claim: The paper proposes a more expressive SSM recurrence, complex-valued state updates, and MIMO formulation; it reports retrieval, state-tracking, and language-modeling results. The official repository contains Mamba-3 code.
sources.limits: Reported evaluations are language/retrieval tasks at large model scales. They do not establish quality on this 112-feature regression task, CPU callback performance, or compatibility with the competition environment.

sources.title: Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality
sources.verified_claim: The paper develops structured state-space duality, relating SSMs and attention through structured semiseparable matrices, and introduces Mamba-2 with an algorithm the authors report as 2–8x faster than Mamba-1 on their language-modeling setup.
sources.limits: The speed claim is specific to the authors' model, kernels, and hardware. The paper does not show a competition-task gain or CPU serving advantage.

sources.title: Gated Delta Networks: Improving Mamba2 with Delta Rule
sources.verified_claim: The paper combines a gate for adaptive memory forgetting with delta-rule updates for targeted memory writing and describes a parallel training algorithm; NVlabs identifies the repository as the official PyTorch implementation.
sources.limits: Evidence comes from language modeling, retrieval, and long-context benchmarks. The local project already has an older negative-point-estimate GDN comparison, so this source does not justify a vanilla rerun.

sources.title: xLSTM: Extended Long Short-Term Memory
sources.verified_claim: The paper extends LSTM with stabilized exponential gates and two memory variants: scalar-memory sLSTM and matrix-memory mLSTM; the official repository provides the authors' implementation.
sources.limits: The paper's main evaluation is language modeling. CUDA/kernel requirements and training results do not establish numeric forecasting quality or CPU callback viability here.

sources.title: Griffin: Mixing Gated Linear Recurrences with Local Attention for Efficient Language Models
sources.verified_claim: The paper presents Hawk gated linear recurrence and Griffin, a hybrid that mixes gated recurrence with local attention. Google's RecurrentGemma repository states that its models are based on Griffin.
sources.limits: Results concern language-model training and inference. The code is an implementation/resource reference, not a drop-in numeric model or evidence of transfer to this task.

sources.title: MOMENT: A Family of Open Time-series Foundation Models
sources.verified_claim: The paper describes time-series foundation models pretrained with masked-patch reconstruction; the author repository includes research code and pretraining workflows.
sources.limits: The reported pretrained models use a public multi-domain time-series corpus. Such external series and pretrained weights are not usable here if they contain external market data; only the training objective is a candidate for adaptation to permitted supplied inputs.

sources.title: SAMformer: Unlocking the Potential of Transformers in Time Series Forecasting with Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Channel-Wise Attention
sources.verified_claim: The authors combine sharpness-aware minimization with a shallow time-series Transformer and report forecasting results, seed variation, and sharpness analyses on their benchmark datasets.
sources.limits: Their architecture, data splits, forecast horizons, and MSE-based evaluation differ from this challenge's recurrent per-row predictions and pooled weighted Pearson score.

sources.title: Learning to (Learn at Test Time): RNNs with Expressive Hidden States
sources.verified_claim: The authors define TTT-Linear and TTT-MLP layers whose hidden state is a model updated by self-supervised learning on the sequence; the repository identifies itself as the official JAX implementation.
sources.limits: Reported evaluations are large language models with accelerator/system optimizations. They do not establish per-row CPU cost, allowed contest semantics for online parameter updates, or label-prediction improvement here.

sources.title: Titans: Learning to Memorize at Test Time
sources.verified_claim: The paper proposes a neural long-term memory module updated at test time and several ways to combine that memory with attention; the NeurIPS paper reports long-context language/retrieval results.
sources.limits: No verified author implementation link was found during this scout. The result does not establish suitability for numeric data, CPU serving, or this challenge's allowed-update interpretation.

sources.title: Context-Matched Distillation: Teacher Causality for Autoregressive Video Distillation
sources.verified_claim: The paper proposes causal teacher scoring and context-matched student distillation for autoregressive video generation; the author repository includes causal teacher and student distillation configurations.
sources.limits: Video diffusion/generation differs substantially from numeric time-series regression. This source motivates an information-set audit, not a forecast-quality claim or permission to use future inputs.

sources.title: Reversible Instance Normalization for Accurate Time-Series Forecasting against Distribution Shift
sources.verified_claim: The paper proposes reversible instance-wise input normalization with learnable affine parameters for time-series forecasting under distribution shift; the repository identifies itself as the official PyTorch implementation.
sources.limits: Standard instance statistics can use a complete input window. For this per-row causal callback, only prefix statistics are legal; the proposed streaming adaptation is not the paper's unchanged method.

sources.title: Unbiasing Truncated Backpropagation Through Time
sources.verified_claim: ARTBP uses random truncation lengths and compensation factors to obtain an unbiased gradient estimator while retaining truncated-backpropagation computational benefits; the paper evaluates synthetic dependency tasks and language modeling.
sources.limits: The paper's tasks do not establish training stability, variance, or score benefit on 20,000-row sequences with this objective.

sources.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
sources.verified_claim: The paper derives an online message-passing algorithm for the posterior distribution over current run length and applies it under a segment-wise generative model.
sources.limits: Exact inference depends on the assumed run-length hazard and segment observation model. No source establishes useful changepoints or target-regime alignment in these anonymous features.

sources.title: Near-Optimal Algorithms for Group Distributionally Robust Optimization and Beyond
sources.verified_claim: The paper studies optimization algorithms for group-DRO, subpopulation fairness, and empirical CVaR objectives, with convergence analyses and experiments.
sources.limits: Meaningful known groups are central to the setup. It does not establish that source components or feature-defined regimes are valid groups for this competition or that its objectives improve pooled weighted correlation.
